name: academia
description: Academia - Mobile academic planner for tasks, exams, study routines, and competitions

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html','gemini-quickadd.js','manifest.webmanifest','service-worker.js','icon-192.png','icon-512.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f); }); console.log('Web assets prepared in www/');"
